text: みた　ことも　ない　ポケモンの　カセキとか　もってるし

structure.jp: みた　ことも　ない　ポケモンの
structure.en: of Pokémon I've never even seen

patterns.name: 〜たことがない
patterns.span: みた　ことも　ない
patterns.explanation: A past verb plus ことがない means you have never done it; も in place of が adds 'even'. Here the whole phrase describes the Pokémon after it. みた　ことも　ない = 'have never even seen'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し at the end gives one reason and hints there are more, like 'and besides'. もってるし = 'he has them, for one thing'.

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.explanation: とか after a word gives it as one example, like 'things like'. カセキとか = 'fossils and such'.
